_note: Every choice gives tokens (no wrong answers). Optional fields: tags (kind/curious/restful - decide your ending), set (flags the world remembers), memory (a line for the journal), item, collect {kind,id}. Event fields: requires (conditions), once, weight. `callbacks` only appear after the flag in `requires` is set.

common.text: A small bird sits on a fence post, one wing tucked in oddly.

choices.label: Carry it to a tree
choices.result: It hops onto a branch and sings a few notes before you leave.
choices.memory: You carried a hurt bird to a tree, and it sang before you left.

choices.label: Leave some seeds
choices.result: You scatter seeds and walk on. Behind you, wings flutter.

common.text: A fox sits on the path holding a tiny lantern in its mouth.

choices.label: Take the lantern
choices.result: It is warm, and lights the road ahead for a while.

choices.label: Sit with the fox
choices.result: You rest together. When you stand, the fox nudges a token into your hand.
choices.memory: You sat with a fox on the road, and it trusted you.

common.text: A stream crosses the path. A few flat stones lie nearby.

choices.label: Build stepping stones
choices.result: You set the stones one by one and cross without getting wet.

choices.label: Wade across
choices.result: The water is cold and clear. Something shiny rests in the mud.

common.text: A mailbox stands alone by the road. It has your name on it.

choices.label: Open it
choices.result: Inside is a folded note and a token. The note says: keep going.
choices.memory: You opened a mailbox with your name on it. It said: keep going.

choices.label: Leave it closed
choices.result: Some things can wait. A token slips out from under the lid anyway.
choices.memory: You left a mailbox with your name on it closed. Some things can wait.

common.text: Wind chimes hang from a tree, though no one is around.

choices.label: Add one of your own
choices.result: The new chime is slightly out of tune, which somehow suits them.
choices.memory: You hung a chime of your own on a stranger's tree.

choices.label: Listen for a while
choices.result: The sound settles you. Your steps feel lighter.

forest.text: A ring of pale mushrooms glows faintly at the foot of an old pine.

choices.label: Step inside the ring
choices.result: The air inside is warmer, and smells of rain that hasn't happened yet.

choices.label: Walk around it
choices.result: It feels polite. Something rustles approvingly.

forest.text: A cabin with smoke curling from its chimney. A sign on the door: 'Kettle's on. Nobody home.'

choices.label: Add a log to the woodpile
choices.result: The pile looks very pleased to have you. A token sits on the doorstep.

choices.label: Peek through the window
choices.result: A table set for two, and a map pinned to the wall, with a star on it.

forest.text: An owl watches you from a low branch, entirely unbothered.

choices.label: Bow to the owl
choices.result: It blinks once, slowly. You feel oddly approved of.

choices.label: Count its blinks
choices.result: Seven blinks, then a feather drifts down onto the path.

meadow.text: The whole meadow is humming. Bees drift from flower to flower like slow thoughts.

choices.label: Lie in the grass and listen
choices.result: You're gone for a little while. When you come back, the hum is part of you.

choices.label: Follow one bee
choices.result: It leads you to a hollow tree, dripping gold. The bees let you take a single drop.

meadow.text: A checkered blanket is spread in the grass. Two cups, one sandwich, no people.

choices.label: Leave a flower on the blanket
choices.result: You tuck a wildflower under a cup. Somewhere, someone will smile.

choices.label: Sit for a minute
choices.result: The sandwich is, mysteriously, exactly what you wanted.

meadow.text: A kite string runs across the path and up into the sky. At the other end, a child waves.

choices.label: Hold the string a while
choices.result: The kite tugs like a living thing. The child laughs and gives you a token.

choices.label: Look for the kite
choices.result: It's a tiny red shape, nearly out of sight. You've never seen anything so brave.

mountains.text: Someone has been building a cairn here, one stone at a time. A flat stone sits ready.

choices.label: Add your stone
choices.result: It fits perfectly, as if it had been saved for you.
choices.memory: You added a stone to a cairn high in the mountains.

choices.label: Admire the view
choices.result: The valley is a green quilt far below. You carry that sight with you.

mountains.text: A mountain goat stands on a ledge that shouldn't be able to hold it.

choices.label: Offer it some bread
choices.result: It eats with enormous dignity, then leaves a token on the rock.

choices.label: Wave and wait
choices.result: It watches you the whole way past, like a very small mountain keeping count.

mountains.text: You call your name into the valley, and the valley answers a moment late.

choices.label: Shout something kind
choices.result: The mountains give it back, bigger. You walk taller for a while.

choices.label: Whisper, to see if it whispers back
choices.result: It does. It whispers back something slightly different from what you said.

snowfields.text: A line of small tracks crosses the snow and stops, as if whoever made them had simply been lifted away.

choices.label: Follow the tracks
choices.result: They end at a tiny snow globe, half buried. You brush it off and it begins, faintly, to glow.

choices.label: Leave them undisturbed
choices.result: Some mysteries are happier unsolved. The snow seems to agree.

snowfields.text: Someone has carved lanterns out of ice and set them along the path. Each holds a small flame.

choices.label: Relight the one that has gone out
choices.result: It catches on the second try, and the whole row seems a little brighter.

choices.label: Walk the line to its end
choices.result: At the end there is nothing, and it is the loveliest nothing you've ever seen.

snowfields.text: A pond has frozen so clearly you can see the fish below, paused like beads on a string.

choices.label: Skate across in your boots
choices.result: You slide ten wonderful feet and fall over, laughing at nobody.

choices.label: Sit on the bank and watch
choices.result: The pond holds its breath with you. Time goes thin and soft.

desert.text: In the middle of a thousand spines, one cactus has bloomed. The flower is the size of a thumbnail.

choices.label: Shade it with your hat
choices.result: A tiny kindness on a very large day. The cactus does not thank you, but it leans.

choices.label: Sit and admire it
choices.result: It lasts a day, they say. You spend an hour of it.

desert.text: An old well stands in the sand. Something at the bottom glints.

choices.label: Lower your lantern to look
choices.result: A small sun-colored stone, warm even after being so long in the dark.

choices.label: Drop in a token for luck
choices.result: You hear it land, and then, faintly, something answers with a ring of its own.

desert.text: You hear a bell, but no caravan. A single bell lies on the sand, still faintly ringing.

choices.label: Ring it back
choices.result: The sound carries a long way. Far off, someone rings in return.

choices.label: Hang it where travelers will find it
choices.result: You hook it onto a crooked post. It sounds better there than it ever did on the ground.

coast.text: A bottle rolls in on the tide with a rolled-up note inside.

choices.label: Read the note
choices.result: It says: 'To whoever finds this: you're doing better than you think.' Kind of the sea.

choices.label: Send it back out unread
choices.result: Some messages are for someone further down the shore.

coast.text: A small crab is rescuing a larger shell with great determination.

choices.label: Help it push
choices.result: Together you win. The crab looks at you with unmistakable pride.

choices.label: Watch it work
choices.result: It takes eleven minutes. It is the best eleven minutes of your day.

coast.text: Someone has left a driftwood fire burning on the beach, banked low and glowing.

choices.label: Feed it a few sticks
choices.result: It leaps up gratefully, throwing shadows that look like dancers.

choices.label: Warm your hands
choices.result: The heat sinks into your shoulders. The sea keeps time behind you.

rare.text: The fireflies drift together and, for a breath, seem to spell something.

choices.label: Read it out loud
choices.result: You say it, and they scatter, laughing in light. The word was your name.

choices.label: Hold very still
choices.result: They settle on your sleeves like a lantern made of living stars.

rare.text: The aurora comes down so low you could almost walk into it.

choices.label: Walk toward it
choices.result: You don't reach it, but the walking is the point. Green light on your hands.

choices.label: Lie back in the snow
choices.result: The whole sky is a slow green river. You float, perfectly warm.

rare.text: On the shimmering horizon, a city of glass appears, and then politely isn't.

choices.label: Wave at it
choices.result: Someone in the heat-haze waves back. You decide not to think about that.

choices.label: Sit in the shade and let it pass
choices.result: It melts away like sugar. You feel inexplicably refreshed.

rare.text: Far out on the water, a dark shape rises, hangs in the light, and slides under again.

choices.label: Wave to the whale
choices.result: A long, low sound rolls across the bay. You choose to believe it was hello.

choices.label: Stand quietly until it's gone
choices.result: The ripples take a very long time to reach the shore.

rare.text: A single snowflake lands on your sleeve and, for a moment, keeps its whole shape.

choices.label: Show it to someone
choices.result: There's nobody around, so you show it to the road. The road seems impressed.

choices.label: Let it melt
choices.result: It goes quietly. You walk lighter for a while.

rare.text: A spiral of leaves lifts off the path, turning in the wind like a slow, orange thought.

choices.label: Step into the spiral
choices.result: For a heartbeat you're inside the season itself. Then it sets you down, gently.

choices.label: Catch a leaf
choices.result: It's the exact color of late afternoon. You press it into your journal.

rare.text: A huge pale moth settles on your lantern and spreads its wings like two small moons.

choices.label: Hold the lantern very steady
choices.result: It rests there, glowing, for a quarter mile of walking.

choices.label: Look closer at its wings
choices.result: There are tiny maps on them. Not a single one is of anywhere you've been.

rare.text: The rain finds a rhythm on a tin roof, a leaf, a barrel, a puddle: a whole orchestra with no conductor.

choices.label: Conduct, just a little
choices.result: The storm swells and softens at your hands. Nobody sees. It is perfect.

choices.label: Stand under the eaves and listen
choices.result: Dry, warm, wholly present. You wouldn't trade this for a sunny day.

callbacks.text: A small bird lands on your shoulder, one wing tucked just so. It's the one you carried to the tree. It has brought a friend.

choices.label: Let them stay a while
choices.result: They ride along for a mile, chattering about everything they've seen since.

choices.label: Hold out a few seeds
choices.result: Both birds eat from your palm. You feel enormously trusted.

callbacks.text: The fox is waiting at the bend, its tiny lantern set neatly beside it, as if it had been saving the matches for you.

choices.label: Light it together
choices.result: The flame catches. For a while the fox walks beside you, and the road is a little less long.

choices.label: Follow the fox
choices.result: It leads you off the road to a hill with a perfect view, then trots back as if that was all.

callbacks.text: Another mailbox, another note. This one says: 'You didn't have to open the last one, but you did. That's why I wrote again.'

choices.label: Keep the note
choices.result: It goes in your pocket, next to the first. You're starting a collection.

choices.label: Write a reply and leave it inside
choices.result: Not sure who it's for. You hope it finds them.

callbacks.text: Another mailbox, and a flag raised on it. This one is addressed: 'For when you're ready.'

choices.label: Open it, now that you're ready
choices.result: Inside: a single token and a drawing of the road you're on. You didn't know someone was drawing it.

choices.label: Still not ready. That's allowed.
choices.result: The flag lowers itself politely. The mailbox will wait.

callbacks.text: You hear it before you see it: the slightly out-of-tune chime you hung. Somebody has added a second one beside it.

choices.label: Add a third
choices.result: The three of them argue sweetly in the wind.

choices.label: Stand and listen to the chorus
choices.result: A stranger's chime and yours, almost in tune. Almost is the best part.

callbacks.text: Your stone is still on the cairn, and a dozen more have joined it.

choices.label: Add another
choices.result: The cairn is a sentence, and everyone who stops adds a word.

choices.label: Sit with it a while
choices.result: A long time ago somebody put the first stone here. You think of them kindly.
